mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments WHERE id=#{id} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_session_assignments SET status=#{a.status},replaced_by_assignment_id=#{a.replacedByAssignmentId},attended_at=#{a.attendedAt},note=#{a.note}, recorded_by=#{a.recordedBy},recorded_at=#{a.recordedAt},updated_at=#{a.updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{a.id} AND organization_id=#{a.organizationId} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status IN ('ASSIGNED','ATTENDED')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments WHERE participant_id=#{participantId} AND status='ATTENDED')
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_session_assignments SET status='CANCELLED',recorded_by=#{actor},recorded_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE participant_id=#{participantId} AND status='ASSIGNED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments a JOIN public.health_examination_participants p ON p.id=a.participant_id WHERE

SELECT a.participant_id, COALESCE(MIN(s.session_date) FILTER (WHERE a.status='ASSIGNED'), MIN(s.session_date) FILTER (WHERE a.status='ATTENDED')) AS examination_date FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments a JOIN public.health_examination_sessions s ON s.id=a.session_id WHERE a.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND a.participant_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.participant_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','ATTENDED')) > 0

SELECT a.id AS assignment_id,a.session_id,s.session_date,s.activity,s.site_type,s.site_address,s.status AS session_status, a.status,a.replaced_by_assignment_id,a.attended_at,a.note,a.row_version FROM public.health_examination_session_assignments a JOIN public.health_examination_sessions s ON s.id=a.session_id WHERE a.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND a.participant_id=#{participantId} ORDER BY s.session_date DESC, a.created_at DESC, a.id ASC
